reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for linking sessions and injecting bounded, read-only snapshots of referenced local conversations into new prompts, with optional browser deep-link handling.

summaries.zh: 用于复制和解析会话深链，将本地会话的有界只读快照注入新对话上下文，并可选支持浏览器直接打开会话。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that links sessions, injects bounded read-only snapshots of local conversations into new prompts, and optionally opens sessions through browser deep links.

capabilities: Reads referenced local session content to create bounded snapshots
Injects read-only session context into prompts
Adds web interface actions for copying and opening session links
Registers a Windows dsh:// URL protocol handler when explicitly installed
